scope: Generic synthetic SQLite fixtures only. No live runtime identifiers, credentials or operational records.

change.archive_format: Unchanged sqlite-online-backup-v1: 4-byte header length, authenticated JSON manifest, 12-byte nonce, ciphertext, 16-byte AES-GCM tag
change.download: Chunked remote body to private temporary file; body closed on failure
change.restore: Authenticate tag, plaintext SHA-256 and size before SQLite read; verify immutable identity and integrity before atomic no-overwrite link
change.retention: Same policy, authenticated proofs and fresh conditional-delete canary; file-backed archive removed in finally before next verification
change.temporary_disk: At most approximately two snapshot-sized temporary files per sequential backup/restore/retention phase; temporary files are removed on normal completion or raised errors

before.transport: disposable disk fixture, no external request

after.transport: disposable disk fixture, no external request

limitations: RSS results are local process measurements using synthetic data and filesystem S3 fixtures; live container memory, filesystem cache and network behavior still require observation.
Disk space remains proportional to snapshot size. Temp storage must be disk-backed with sufficient free space.
This change does not certify math/RNG, external operator wallets, independent security review or go-live approval.
